q1_issues.issue: Minting `sk_abuse_1` as a top-level witness asserts that an abuse eventuality exists, whereas the text only names the offense a charge is of — and the three sibling conjuncts are (correctly) left as bare kind symbols.
`(Member sk_body_1 body)` plus `(Member sk_body_1 dead)` assert that a specific dead body exists, content supplied only by the name of the charge.

q2_gaps: criminal charge / allegation framing ("faces multiple counts of X") — no construct records charged-but-unproven content without asserting it (attitudes, AccordingTo and the seals all need an attitude verb or an explicit attribution phrase)

the count-of-offense relation ("counts of burial service fraud") — "count" is a relational noun, not a nominalization whose underlying verb takes the of-NP as object, so neither the `Of` argument-oblique nor the relational-noun `Possession` route clearly applies
"multiple" as a vague-quantity phrase is not in the CardinalityPhrase lexicon the instructions enumerate (a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of)
notes: The age appositive, the multi-word `Name`, the stative-transitive `Agent`, and the compound decompositions (fraud genus, verb_object make_false_statement, false_statement modifier genus) all follow the instruction set. Using the mnemonic group stem `sk_counts_1` with only one group in play is permitted-but-unusual.
